cohort: Singleton live birth deliveries between 2004 and 2017 conceived with autologous assisted reproductive technology cycles with fresh blastocyst transfer
finding: Compared to sequential culture, single-step embryo culture was associated with increased odds of large-for-gestational-age (LGA) infants, but not with other obstetric or perinatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Low birth weight, large-for-gestational-age (LGA), and small-for-gestational-age were assessed as outcomes.
